name: nvm
description: Node Version Manager - POSIX-compliant bash script to manage multiple active node.js versions.
one_liner: A free command-line tool that lets developers switch between different versions of Node.js on their computer.
buyer: No real buyer — this is free developer infrastructure that essentially every Node.js developer already uses at no cost.
business_use_cases: A dev shop uses it internally to keep every project pinned to the right Node version across the team.
A bootcamp includes it in required setup instructions so students have consistent environments.
An onboarding script for new engineering hires auto-installs it to standardize local dev environments.

money_ideas.idea: None realistic for the tool itself — it's foundational free infrastructure, not a product anyone would pay for directly

steal_this: There isn't one — this is plumbing, not a business opportunity; skip it.
